heading.en: When should a firm close its doors?

hook.en: A firm making a loss does not always shut down. If it closes, it still pays rent. Today we find the exact price at which closing is better.
hook.kn: ನಷ್ಟದಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆ ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ ಮುಚ್ಚುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಮುಚ್ಚಿದರೂ ಬಾಡಿಗೆ ಕಟ್ಟಲೇಬೇಕು. ಮುಚ್ಚುವುದೇ ಉತ್ತಮವಾಗುವ ನಿಖರ ಬೆಲೆಯನ್ನು ಇಂದು ಕಂಡುಹಿಡಿಯೋಣ.

title.en: Short-run supply curve and the shut-down point

body.en: A firm's supply curve shows the output it chooses at each market price. In the short run the firm produces where p = SMC, but only if $p \ge$ minimum AVC; if price is lower, it cannot cover even its variable cost and shuts down, losing only its TFC. So the short-run supply curve is the rising part of the SMC curve from the minimum AVC upward, and zero output for lower prices. The point of minimum AVC is the short-run shut-down point.

points.en: SR supply = rising SMC above min AVC
Below min AVC: q = 0, loss = TFC

narration.en: In the short run the firm supplies along its rising marginal cost curve above minimum AVC. Below minimum AVC it shuts down.
narration.kn: ಅಲ್ಪಾವಧಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಯು ಕನಿಷ್ಠ AVC ಗಿಂತ ಮೇಲಿರುವ ಏರುತ್ತಿರುವ ಸೀಮಾಂತ ವೆಚ್ಚ ರೇಖೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಪೂರೈಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಕನಿಷ್ಠ AVC ಗಿಂತ ಕೆಳಗೆ ಉತ್ಪಾದನೆ ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

say.en: Here are the firm's SMC, AVC and AC curves. AVC is lowest at 6 rupees, when output is 4.
AC is lowest at 13 rupees, when output is 6. At this price total revenue just equals total cost: the break-even point.
The supply curve is the SMC curve from S upward. Below 6 rupees, the firm supplies nothing.

title.en: Normal profit, break-even point and long-run supply

body.en: Normal profit is the minimum profit a firm needs to stay in business; it is counted as part of total cost. Profit above it is super-normal profit. The point where SMC cuts the AC curve at its minimum is the break-even point: here TR = TC and the firm earns only normal profit. In the long run all costs are variable, so the firm shuts down if price is below minimum LRAC; the long-run supply curve is the rising part of LRMC from minimum LRAC upward.

points.en: Break-even: p = min AC, TR = TC
Normal profit is included in cost
LR supply = rising LRMC above min LRAC

narration.en: Normal profit is the minimum profit needed to stay in business. At the break-even point, price equals minimum average cost. In the long run the firm supplies along LRMC above minimum LRAC.
narration.kn: ವ್ಯವಹಾರದಲ್ಲಿ ಉಳಿಯಲು ಬೇಕಾದ ಕನಿಷ್ಠ ಲಾಭ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಲಾಭ. ಸಮಚ್ಛೇದ ಬಿಂದುವಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಲೆ ಕನಿಷ್ಠ ಸರಾಸರಿ ವೆಚ್ಚಕ್ಕೆ ಸಮ. ದೀರ್ಘಾವಧಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕನಿಷ್ಠ LRAC ಗಿಂತ ಮೇಲಿನ LRMC ಯೇ ಪೂರೈಕೆ ರೇಖೆ.

aim.en: To find the output at which total revenue equals total cost (zero profit) from a break-even chart.

narration.en: The break-even chart plots total revenue and total cost lines. Where they cross, the firm covers all its costs and earns only normal profit.

problem.en: A firm has TFC = ₹30. Its AVC for 1 to 5 units is ₹20, 15, 12, 12.5, 15 and its AC is ₹50, 30, 22, 20, 21. Find the shut-down price and the break-even price. What will it do if the price is ₹10?

steps.en: At ₹10 < ₹12 the firm cannot cover variable cost, so it shuts down and its loss is TFC = ₹30.

answer.en: Shut-down price ₹12; break-even price ₹20; at ₹10 the firm shuts down (loss ₹30).

homework.en: Draw a diagram showing the shut-down point and the break-even point of a firm.

narration.en: Recap. SR supply: rising SMC above min AVC. Shut-down point: p = min AVC. Break-even point: p = min AC; only normal profit. LR supply: rising LRMC above min LRAC.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಅಲ್ಪಾವಧಿ ಪೂರೈಕೆ: ಕನಿಷ್ಠ AVC ಗಿಂತ ಮೇಲಿನ ಏರುತ್ತಿರುವ SMC. ಸ್ಥಗಿತ ಬಿಂದು: p = ಕನಿಷ್ಠ AVC. ಸಮಚ್ಛೇದ ಬಿಂದು: p = ಕನಿಷ್ಠ AC; ಕೇವಲ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಲಾಭ. ದೀರ್ಘಾವಧಿ ಪೂರೈಕೆ: ಕನಿಷ್ಠ LRAC ಗಿಂತ ಮೇಲಿನ ಏರುತ್ತಿರುವ LRMC.
